classes.hints: THIS IS THE PREDICTED DISSOCIATOR (D18): the whole point of this entry for hypothesis testing is whether info_processing and adaptive_capacity finally come apart (r=0.957 at n=15 — a BZ reaction plausibly processes information in the excitable-medium sense while having essentially zero adaptive capacity: no memory across runs, no variation-selection, no learning). CHAOS_SENSITIVITY — THE STAR COLUMN: BZ in a continuously stirred tank reactor (CSTR) is one of the very few systems anywhere with EXPERIMENTALLY ESTABLISHED low-dimensional deterministic chaos — strange-attractor reconstruction from measured bromide-potential time series: Simoyi, Wolf & Swinney 1982 (PRL 49:245, period-doubling cascade in BZ) and Roux, Simoyi & Swinney 1983 (Physica D 8:257, the reconstructed attractor; Texas group). Top sweep priority: primary-read one of the two Swinney-group papers. CRITICALITY: expect 0, mechanism_status: none — a limit-cycle oscillation is precisely the 'oscillation is not criticality' case the v0.2 boundary rules were written for (schema/anchors/criticality.yaml does_not_count: 'not general nonlinearity'; events-not-structure: no scale-invariant event statistics exist for BZ to our knowledge — if the sweep finds a published avalanche/event-statistics claim for chemical waves, apply power-law-rigor hard and record honestly, but do not go hunting to inflate the score). TIPPING_TRANSITIONS: the oscillation onset is a Hopf bifurcation with published bifurcation analyses (Oregonator parameter space; CSTR bistability between steady states and oscillation is ALSO experimentally established — bistable CSTR regimes are standard in this literature, e.g. De Kepper/Boissonade/Epstein systematic-design work) — per single-modeled-mechanism-is-2 this plausibly scores 2; the bistability satisfies alternative-stable-state-required cleanly (two attractors at identical feed parameters). Nauk SSSR 30:301, K41 — -5/3 inertial-range spectrum E(k)=C*epsilon^(2/3)*k^(-5/3); the 1991 Proc R Soc London A 434 English translations are the standard citable form), Frisch 1995 'Turbulence: The Legacy of A.N. Kolmogorov' (the standard monograph, includes the intermittency story), Reynolds 1883 (Phil Trans R Soc 174:935 — the original transition experiment, pipe-flow transition Re ~2000-2300 [boundary-condition-dependent, cite the modern value with its source, e.g. Avila et al. 2011 Science 333:192 gives Re_c~2040 for the puff-splitting balance point]). All [unverified — model knowledge] until fetched. CRITICALITY — POTENTIALLY THE CATALOG'S STRONGEST CASE, HANDLE WITH FULL RIGOR: the laminar-turbulent transition in shear flows has a RECENT, RIGOROUS critical-phenomena literature — the transition belongs to the directed-percolation (DP) universality class: Lemoult et al. 2016 (Nature Physics 12:254, Couette flow, measured DP critical exponents), Sano & Tamai 2016 (Nature Physics 12:249, channel flow, same issue — the paired experimental demonstrations), Barkley 2016 (J Fluid Mech theoretical framework), plus Hof et al. 2008 / Avila et al. 2011 (Science — puff lifetime and splitting statistics, super-exponential scaling, the Re_c~2040 balance point).
